description: This file defines a static internal class 'GrainMetricsListener' that manages metrics collection for grains in Orleans. It sets up a MeterListener to listen for specific instrument publications and records grain counts based on measurements.

classes.name: GrainMetricsListener
classes.description: A static class that listens to metrics related to grains and updates grain counts accordingly.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the MeterListener to begin listening for measurement events.

methods.name: OnMeasurementRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when a measurement is recorded; updates grain counts based on measurement value.
